title: Assistive Partner Product Upload Form - Accessibility Test Plan (WCAG 2.1 AA)
overview: Comprehensive accessibility test plan for Assistive Partner Product Upload Form covering WCAG 2.1 AA compliance for multi-section form with text inputs, dropdowns, file uploads, image management, and GenAI assistance features.

testCases.title: Verify keyboard navigation through entire form
testCases.componentElement: Product Upload form - all sections
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as approved AP on Product Upload form
steps: 2. Press Tab through all form sections
3. Verify tab order: Basic Info → Features → Images → Video → Specs → Geography → Quantity → Additional Info
4. Verify focus indicator on each field
expectedResults: Form sections navigable in logical order
testCases.postconditions: All form fields verified keyboard accessible

testCases.title: Verify form structure and landmarks
testCases.wcagCriterion: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships, 2.4.6 Headings and Labels
testCases.componentElement: Product Upload form structure and headings
testCases.preconditions: Screen reader enabled, user on Product Upload form
expectedResults: Form instructions announced by screen reader
testCases.postconditions: Form structure and landmarks verified accessible

testCases.title: Verify help icons accessibility
testCases.componentElement: Help icons on form fields
testCases.preconditions: User on Product Upload form with help icons visible
steps: 1. Navigate to field with help icon
expectedResults: Help icon accessible name: 'Help for [field name]'
Help text appears in accessible manner
Help content announced by screen reader

testCases.title: Verify text input labels and associations
testCases.wcagCriterion: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships, 4.1.2 Name Role Value
testCases.componentElement: Text input fields (Product Name, Short Description, Detailed Description)
testCases.preconditions: User on Product Upload form, screen reader enabled
steps: 3. Check Short Description character limit announcement
5. Verify all text inputs have labels
expectedResults: Labels use <label> with for attribute or aria-labelledby
testCases.postconditions: Text input labels and associations verified

testCases.title: Verify text input validation errors
testCases.componentElement: Text input validation error messages
testCases.preconditions: User on Product Upload form with required fields empty
steps: 1. Submit form with empty required fields
testCases.postconditions: Text input validation errors verified accessible

testCases.title: Verify character counter accessibility
testCases.componentElement: Character counter on Short Description field
testCases.preconditions: User on Product Upload form, focused on Short Description field

testCases.title: Verify dropdown accessibility (Product Type, Disability Type)
testCases.componentElement: Product Type and Disability Type dropdowns
testCases.preconditions: User on Product Upload form, focused on dropdown fields

testCases.title: Verify multi-select dropdown (Disability Type)
testCases.componentElement: Disability Type multi-select dropdown
testCases.preconditions: User on Product Upload form, focused on Disability Type field

testCases.preconditions: User on Product Upload form, Geography section visible
